svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Side plates: two, 6 mm, 300 long x 140 tall, with a 70 mm round boss

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: at 100 up; 26 mm axle hole at its centre. 236 apart (centres).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Foot plates: 80 x 6 mm, 300 long, welded under each side plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tie bars: two 20 mm round bars between the side plates, 120 ahead

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: of and behind the axle, 40 up. Weld, then galvanise.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Roller: UHMW-PE 100 OD x 200 long, 26 mm bore; two UHMW-PE flanges

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 160 OD x 10 bolted or pressed on the ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Axle: stainless 316, 25 mm, 260 long, R-clip holes 8 from each end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The saddle sits astride the bund crest with the rope over the roller,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: so the rope never cuts the bund. Roller top 150 above the crest.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: 5 mm clear between the flanges and the side plates.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the roller spins freely; the feet sit flat on a board.
